description: Defines template classes QueueType and CategoryQueueType for thread-safe queue management with features like priority categories, dynamic thresholds, and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: QueueType
classes.description: A thread-safe queue template class with methods for adding, removing, and managing queue entries, including synchronization and state management.

classes.name: CategoryQueueType
classes.description: A categorized, thread-safe queue template class supporting multiple priority levels, dynamic thresholds, and advanced synchronization features.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an entry from the queue if present.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Adds an entry to the queue.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Attempts to insert an entry with optional waiting if the queue is full.

methods.name: Extract
methods.description: Retrieves and removes an entry from the queue, with optional waiting.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables the queue, preventing further operations.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all entries from the queue.

methods.name: HasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific entry exists in the queue.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Applies a provided action to each entry in the queue.

methods.name: Completion
methods.description: Marks a queued entry as completed and manages internal state accordingly.
